subject: Re: Security & IAM follow-up / vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security & IAM follow-up / vendor questionnaire

Hi Marissa / Vivek,

Thanks again for the call earlier. A couple quick items from our side as we kick off procurement for the pilot:

- Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 status and whether you have a HIPAA BAA option?
- We'd like to start the vendor security questionnaire (attached). Please let us know who on your team will own this and an expected turnaround time.
- Primary areas we'll need evidence for: SSO/SAML setup, SCIM provisioning, RBAC/admin controls, and audit logs.

If convenient, please also share any sample SAML metadata and a provisioning guide so our IdP team can pre-check compatibility.

Appreciate it happy to schedule a short follow-up with our security team if helpful.

Thanks,
John Sullivan
Head of IT Security
Acme Health

Attachment: acme_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & IAM follow-up / vendor questionnaire

Hi John great to meet you on the call. Recap & next steps below.

Recap:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) in Nov 2025. We can share the report under an NDA.
- HIPAA: We support PHI workloads via our Private deployment and offer a BAA for customers that require it.
- IAM: We support SSO/SAML (IdP-initiated & SP-initiated), SCIM provisioning for user lifecycle, and fine-grained RBAC + admin controls with audit logging.

Requested artifacts we can provide immediately:
1) SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml) sample SP metadata you can upload to your IdP.
2) SCIM provisioning guide (scim-provisioning-guide.pdf) attribute mapping + provisioning endpoints.
3) RBAC admin matrix (we'll provide a downloadable CSV with role-to-permission mapping).
4) Audit log extract sample (events covering sign-in and admin changes) can provide a redacted sample for the last 90 days.

Proposed next steps:
- Attached initial artifacts (SAML metadata + SCIM guide) for your IdP team to validate.
- Neha (copied) will own the security questionnaire and technical deep-dive; she can take the acme_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx and map answers.
- If useful, schedule a 45-minute technical call this week for the IdP/SRE teams to walk through SCIM mappings and a test provisioning account.

Please let us know a preferred time and any additional specifics (ACS URL, Entity ID, SCIM attributes you expect).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml, scim-provisioning-guide.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & IAM follow-up / vendor questionnaire

Hi John Neha here from Redwood SE. I'll own the questionnaire and technical artifacts. A few asks to speed validation: 

1) For SAML: please confirm your ACS URL(s) and Entity ID(s) and whether you require NameID in email format vs persistent.
2) For SCIM: which attributes do you expect for provisioning (email, displayName, jobTitle, manager)? we'll map them in the guide but want to confirm.
3) RBAC: we'll attach the RBAC matrix; can you confirm which Acme roles (e.g., IdP-admins, App-admins, SRE) should map to Redwood roles for pilot?
4) Audit logs: what date range and event types do you require? we can provide a redacted CSV covering sign-in, token changes, and admin role modifications.

I've attached our IAM evidence checklist and will start populating the vendor questionnaire with answers sending a tracked copy to you by EOD Monday. If you can share your preferred SAML/SCIM values to the Drive link below, that will save time.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-IAM-evidence

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions Engineer
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: iam_evidence_checklist.xlsx

From: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & IAM follow-up / vendor questionnaire

Thanks Marissa / Neha this is helpful. A couple quick asks: 

- Please add the RBAC matrix CSV to the Drive folder when ready (we'd like a crosswalk to our IdP roles).
- We'll send the completed questionnaire back by Wed; in the meantime can you send a DocuSign NDA link for the SOC 2 report request?

I'll coordinate with our IdP admin to upload the sample metadata and test a provisioning account early next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

John
Head of IT Security, Acme Health
